holdout_card.fact_statement: The SPD and CDU/CSU parliamentary groups reached a coalition agreement on 9 April.
holdout_card.source_span: On 9 April, both SPD and the CDU/CSU parliamentary groups had reached a coalition agreement to form a new cabinet under Friedrich Merz’s chancellorship.

qa_variants.question: On what date did the SPD and CDU/CSU parliamentary groups reach a coalition agreement to form the Merz cabinet?
qa_variants.source_span: On 9 April, both SPD and the CDU/CSU parliamentary groups had reached a coalition agreement to form a new cabinet under Friedrich Merz’s chancellorship.
